name: NXP AIM 2025
desc: Winner of NXP AIM 2025. Built a ROS2-based autonomous warehouse surveillance system with navigation, task planning, and computer vision.

name: Vision-and-Language Navigation
desc: Instruction-guided navigation agent using CMA Policy in Habitat Simulator. Uses ResNet, LSTM encoders and cross-modal attention for multimodal navigation learning.

name: Inter-IIT Tech Meet 14.0 - Eternal
desc: Distributed robotic software system using ROS2 for warehouse inventory automation. Integrated LiDAR, IMU, encoders, and camera data to enable SLAM-based mapping.

name: AgriBuddy - Geospatial Digital Twin
desc: Geospatial interface for agriculture yield prediction with automated soil profile injection trained with XGBoost. Containerized FastAPI backend with Docker and Kubernetes.

name: Smart Farm Intrusion Detection
desc: A low-power edge AI system for detecting and deterring wildlife entering farmland. Uses CV, and lightweight ML models to identify animals and trigger non-lethal deterrents.

name: RISC-V Assembler
desc: Web-based RISC-V assembly IDE with an interactive code editor, real-time assembly, machine code generation and step-by-step debugging.
